title: Soul's Takeover
description: Turns your server into ghouls! you all now have a limited amount of souls.
body:
# 👻 Soul's Takeover 

## ✨ Key Features
### **👻 The Soul System**
Players start their journey with a set number of Souls (Default: 5). Every death costs a Soul. If you lose them all, you are Death-Banned from the server.

Max Capacity: By default, players can hold **up to 8 Souls.**

Soul Drops: When a player dies, their lost soul drops as a item at their location.

Absorption: If you come across a Soul Right-click it to absorb it

**💖 The Revival Totem**

Bring back your fallen allies! Players can craft a Revival Totem.

Right-clicking the totem opens a GUI listing every player currently death-banned. Clicking a player's head unbans them and resets their Souls to the starting amount.

### ⚙️ Fully Configurable

Almost **everything** can be tweaked in the config.yml:
- Starting and Maximum Soul counts.
- Toggleable Death Ban system.
- Custom Item Materials, Names, and Lore.
- Fully customizable Crafting Recipes.
- Every message and prefix.

**_🛠️ Commands & Permissions_**
1. /soul withdraw	Withdraw one of your soul's
1. /soul check <player>	Check soul counts
1. /soul give <player> <#>	Give a soul to a player	soul.admin (OP)
1. /soul set <player> <#>	Set a player's soul count (OP)
1. /soul revive <player> revive someone!
1. /soul reload	Reload the configuration (OP)
Just drop it into your plugins folder, and you're ready to go!
